feasibility_reasoning: Option B rests on the claim that "CSS already lays out mobile correctly" (BuilderRenderer.tsx:237-241), and the code only half supports it. The @media (max-width:767px) block covers only columns-row and column-slot (styles.css:2514-2534). About 30 mobile rules are keyed only on [data-device="mobile"], with no media-query twin: styles.css:1839-1844, 2553-2652, 2814 and 2935-2967. Per-device builder values are also resolved in JS for every widget: styleToCSS (frame.ts:44-63), hoverCss (ChromeWidgetView.tsx:235), typography CSS (:291, the source of the 25 style swaps), frame height (:301) and BuilderWidgetNode.tsx:85. Menus branch on mobile (ChromeWidgetView.tsx:979,985) and hideOn filters widgets (frame.ts:252, BuilderRenderer.tsx:823). Option A as written is impossible: passing a `device` prop makes the effect return before it observes (BuilderRenderer.tsx:251-253), so tablets are never corrected. Admin previews depend on that behaviour and builderRenderer.device.test.tsx pins it. The cache key is host::pathname (documentCache.ts:233), and revalidationHeaders forwards UA but not sec-ch-ua-mobile (server.ts:139-146).
blocking_issues: Option B: about 30 [data-device=mobile]-only CSS rules (styles.css:1839-1844, 2553-2652, 2814, 2935-2967) and JS per-device resolution in useWidgetFrame (ChromeWidgetView.tsx:195,235,291,301; frame.ts:44-63) must become media-query CSS for every widget. That adds inline <style> bytes (conflicts with html-weight), the effort is above M, and without it phones keep desktop-resolved values for 10 s or more and then reflow (field-CLS risk). The fixture has no responsive overrides, so tests would not catch it.

Option B trigger 'first user interaction' moves the whole-tree re-render plus a commit/recalc of about 45 ms at 1x into the first tap, an INP regression for real users. 'All islands hydrated' does not exist before H7.

Option A: the `device` prop disables ResizeObserver (BuilderRenderer.tsx:251-253, pinned by builderRenderer.device.test.tsx). It needs a new initialDevice prop and an SSR-to-client channel; __root.tsx has no request-header access today.

Option A: the document cache key host::pathname?query (documentCache.ts:233) needs a device dimension (doubles MISS per URL). revalidationHeaders (server.ts:139-146) does not forward sec-ch-ua-mobile, so a revalidated mobile entry could be stored under the wrong variant unless the classifier falls back to UA identically. Vary is also needed.

Scope is overstated: only the main content renderer switches. The header renderer sits in `hidden lg:block` (Header.tsx:267, width 0, never switches) and the footer (cv-auto) did not switch within 8 s in the verify run.
effect_reasoning: What-if: transform hydration-H6/no-device-switch.mjs makes ResizeObserver ignore [data-builder-renderer]. verify.mjs confirmed it: baseline flips at 1502 ms, patched has 0 flips, and scrollHeight and layout are identical. LH A/B, 3 interleaved mobile runs: TBT A 378 (301-399) vs B 410 (395-436), delta +32 ms, which is noise. FCP, LCP, SI and CLS are unchanged. Main-thread work fell by a median of 1.3 s simulated, but the pairs were +66, -1323 and -1460, so that is mostly noise. Lantern explains why TBT does not move. The switch is a startTransition, so its render yields every 5 ms; 5-14 ms observed x4 = 20-56 ms simulated, at or under the 50 ms threshold, about 0-30 ms TBT in total. Only the commit plus recalc does not yield: 166-198 ms at 4x devtools is about 45 ms at 1x, and as a layout task it gets mult 2, so about 90 ms simulated and about 40 ms TBT. The plan's -150..-300 came from the 2512 vs 3056 ms desktop-vs-mobile-viewport React delta under devtools 4x throttling, where the transition is starved until 7.4 s. That is confounded, and it is CPU time, not blocking time. Desktop: 0, because 1350 px resolves to desktop and nothing switches. LCP and FCP are not on the path.
corrected_estimate: Mobile TBT in the harness: 0 to -60 ms (measured +32 ms ± noise, n=3 interleaved), which is 0 to +1.5 points. PSI production upper bound -40..-150 ms (+1 to +3.5 points), only if the PSI host runs the commit+recalc 2-3x slower; not demonstrated. Desktop 0. FCP/LCP/SI 0. Effect on TTI and main-thread CPU only: about -0.1..-0.3 s observed CPU on phones. Do not count it toward mobile 85. Keep it (option A with an initialDevice prop and a keyed cache) only as an H7 precondition and for field INP/CPU. The TBT lever is task length and yielding plus H7.
better_alternative: For TBT, cap task length and yield, plus H7 islands. The LA what-if showed no task over 12 ms observed takes TBT 356 -> 0. If you want a cheap H6 partial: compute a hasResponsiveOverrides flag in safeParseBuilderDoc and skip the viewport switch when the document has no per-device overrides or hideOn. On the fixture and the production homepage that is a zero-visual-change removal of the switch, but expect about 0 TBT gain in Lantern.
